## Purpose
:::: {style="font-size: 65%;"}
- **Knowledge**: Learn to schedule flexible jobs
- **Skill**:
    - Pass and capture arguments
    - Redirect output and error messages
    - Build wrapper and job scripts
    - Submit and check jobs
- **Why**:
    - Deploy a common workflow for all subjects
    - Protect important scripts from requiring edits
::::

## Capture positional arguments

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%" style="font-size: 65%;"}
- Recall anatomy of shell command:
    - `$ CMD OPT PARAM`
    - `$ mkdir -p foo/bar`
- Commands have 0-indexed positions
    - `0`: `mkdir`
    - `1`: `-p`
    - `2`: `foo/bar`
- Positional arguments can be accessed in scripts
    - Held in special variable `$[index]`
    - e.g. `$0`, `$1`, `$2` ...
:::

::::

## Redirect output: STDOUT

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%" style="font-size: 65%;"}
- `STDOUT`: output of succesful jobs (exit status 0)
- Designated via `&1`
- Normally `&1` is the terminal window
- Can be redirected to a file with `>`
    - `>`: overwrites
    - `>>`: appends
:::

:::: {.column width="\"50%"}
![](stdout_1.png)
::::
:::::


## Redirect output: STDERR

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%" style="font-size: 65%;"}
- `STDERR`: output of failed jobs (exit status >0)
- Designated via `2>`
- Normally `2>` is the terminal window
- Can be redirected to a file with `2>`
    - `2> err.log`: send STDERR to err.log
    - `2>&1`: send STDERR to same location as STDOUT
    - `cmd > out.log 2>&1`: Send STDOUT and STDERR to out.log
:::

:::: {.column width="\"50%"}
![](stderr_1.png)

::: {.incremental style="font-size: 65%;"}
- Notice:
    - Line 7 printed to `err.log`
    - Line 8 printed to terminal
:::
::::
:::::

## Job Scripts

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%" style="font-size: 65%;"}
- Compute environments involve scheduled jobs
    - e.g. execute workflow A for subjects 1, 2, and 3
- OK: edit job scripts for each subject
- Better: pass subject number to job script
- Job script purpose:
    - Request resources
    - Receive arguments
    - Execute workflow
:::

- Common: Load modules in job script

## Wrapper Scripts

:::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%" style="font-size: 65%;"}
- Wrapper script purpose:
    - Submits job script by envoking `qsub` command
    - Passes arguments to the job script
- Used as the researcher-editable file
    - No need to edit job script
- Research could pass args to wrapper script
    - (more advanced)
:::

## Make log directory

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%" style="font-size: 65%;"}
- Scheduled job runs on non-interactive node
    - STDOUT and STDERR are sent to `[job_name].o[job_id]`
- Redirect STDOUT and STDERR with `-o` and `-e` options
    - CRC `qsub` configuration directs `2>&1`
- Good habit to organize STDOUT/ERR in logging directory
    - Named for job
    - Time stamp helps trouble shoot
    - See [here](https://www.cyberciti.biz/faq/unix-linux-bash-get-time/) for information on `date`
:::

## Check status: qstat

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%" style="font-size: 65%;"}
- Check status of submitted jobs with `qstat`
    - `qstat -u username`: status for all user jobs
    - `qstat -j jobid`: status for specific jobs
- Number of statuses possible:
    - `r`: job is running
    - `qw`: job is queued, waiting for resources
    - `Eqw`: invalid job
- See more options [here](https://docs.adaptivecomputing.com/torque/4-1-3/Content/topics/commands/qstat.htm)
:::

:::: {.column width="\"50%" style="font-size: 65%;"}

![](qstat_1.png)

::: {.incremental}
- Set an alias for things your type often!
:::
::::
:::::

## Delete jobs: qdel

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%" style="font-size: 65%;"}
- Sometimes necessary to kill jobs
    - Incorrect specification
    - Syntax error (e.g. no increment in while loops)
- Determine job ID with `qstat`
- `qdel jobid`: Terminates specified job
- See more options [here](https://docs.adaptivecomputing.com/torque/3-0-5/commands/qdel.php)
:::

:::: {.column width="\"50%" style="font-size: 65%;"}
![](qdel_1.png)
::::
:::::

## Long queue times

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%" style="font-size: 65%;"}
- Sometimes jobs queue (status `qw`) for a ***long*** time
    - Beginning of semster (students learning)
    - End of semester (students running final projects)
    - Teams conducting large analyses
    - ***Your request is large***
- Tips:
    - Optimize resource usage
    - Consider parent and child jobs
    - Consider job [arrays](https://docs.crc.nd.edu/new_user/quick_start.html#job-arrays)
    - Lower cluster use at night, on weekends
- `qstat`: (without options) check entire queue
:::

:::: {.column width="\"50%" style="font-size: 65%;"}

![](qstat_2.png)

::: {.incremental}
- See [here](https://bash.cyberciti.biz/guide/Pipes) for using `|` (pipes)
:::
